description: Asset check that verifies an MLflow registered model's state (exists / at required stage / within a freshness window).

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Asset key this check attaches to (dot-separated for hierarchical keys).

check_name.label: Check Name
check_name.description: Unique name for this asset check.

tracking_uri_env_var.label: Tracking Uri Env Var
tracking_uri_env_var.description: Env var holding the MLflow Tracking URI.

required_stage.label: Required Stage
required_stage.description: If set, the model must have at least one version at this stage.

required_version.label: Required Version
required_version.description: If set, this specific version must exist in the registry.

max_age_days.label: Max Age Days
max_age_days.description: If set, the latest version at required_stage (or overall) must have been created within this many days. Freshness gate — useful to catch stale production models.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: ERROR blocks downstream materialization; WARN just flags in the UI.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var for HTTP-basic MLflow auth username (optional).

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var for HTTP-basic MLflow auth password (optional).
